prereg.title: CB2-S2c (r6): continue from S2b (initial policy and KL anchor), gamma 0.995, death penalty 10, 100 iterations; sealed 91001-91080
prereg.authority: DAV-91: S2b sealed S2-PROGRESS (bc3a678), installed in cb2-ind-0001 (d09e426). S2c drafted on DAV-91 (2026-10-09 21:22Z); David: 'Please help me start pod' (2026-10-09 16:52 CT). Locked before any S2c outcome exists.

reference.what: frozen candidates/s2b-final: initial policy, KL anchor, sealed comparator; the canonical's current skill

changes_from_S2b.reference: S2b instead of r3h-B (initial policy, KL anchor, comparator)
changes_from_S2b.gamma: 0.995 instead of 0.99 (horizon ~200 steps: food/drink deaths, ~54% of S2b training deaths, build over hundreds of steps)
changes_from_S2b.development: 76001-76120 at iteration 0 (S2b) and every 20 iterations (20, 40, 60, 80, 100): 5 candidates
changes_from_S2b.sealed: 91001-91080 (80 worlds, sealed block 2, never used; ledger: sealed-ledger.json)

prereg.fixed: the scripted executor organ, the r2 core (frozen), the vision organ v1, the language stand-in; only the selector (and a value head) learns

learner.algorithm: PPO over the 8 organ commands, one command per step, + beta*KL(pi||pi_r3hB) per step + entropy bonus
learner.value_head: MLP on the detached selector trunk
learner.beta_rule: x2 if the iteration's mean KL to r3h-B > 1.5 * 0.02; /2 if < 0.02 / 1.5
learner.early_stop: an update stops when the approximate KL to the rollout policy exceeds 0.05
learner.sampling: temperature 1, a pure function of (iteration, life, step)

prereg.reward: training: reward['total'] - 10 * [terminal death step]; reported: the environment's own reward components, the penalty total per life, as before

red_flags_reported: training reward rising while development survival or requests fall
anti_hacking.added: 'hiding' check: command share of 'rest' and Crafter unlocks per life logged per iteration; the sealed score gate (>= 1.0x routine) and requests gate (>= 0.85x) make pure hiding fail

development.selection: the checkpoint with the best mean development survival among those whose development Crafter score >= S2b's (iteration 0); if none is eligible: no candidate, the sealed set is not opened

prereg.post_install_check: the installed s2c-final, under the unchanged cb2_evaluate, must reproduce its development life on 76001 (survival steps and unlocks); otherwise stop before the sealed set

arms: S2c candidate (paired with the routine on the same worlds, unchanged cb2_evaluate protocol)
sealed.bootstrap: paired per-world differences; one-sided 95% lower bound = 5th percentile of 10,000 bootstrap means, numpy default_rng(20261009)

verdicts.S2c_complete_beyond_routine: all of: (1) lower bound of paired survival (S2 - routine) > 0; (2) Crafter score >= 1.0x routine; (3) requests on time >= 0.85x the routine's rate (aggregate counts); (4) continuity as in r3-H (integrity, save/restore, consolidation round-trip, replay of 90041, 100% delegation provenance); no protocol deviation
verdicts.S2c_progress: if not complete: lower bound of paired survival (S2c - S2b) > 0 AND score >= S2b's score on the same worlds AND (3) AND (4)
verdicts.no_improvement: otherwise (reported as such; no post-hoc retuning on the sealed set)

prereg.integrity: any crash, missing world, corrupted artifact or protocol deviation is reported as such, never silently rerun
prereg.gate4: OPEN: S2 does not address prediction / persistent memory
prereg.note: report keys 'vs_r3hB' / 'score_r3hB' in s2c-sealed-report.json name the comparator slot; here the comparator is S2b (comparator_name)

selection.rule: best development survival among checkpoints with development score >= r3h-B's (iteration 0)
